name: Roadworthy Title & Registration
tagline: Your Story with Panicci Ventures — Video Testimonial
introHtml: Thanks for doing this — it means a lot. A few quick questions about our work together. Just talk naturally, 30–60 seconds each. No script to memorize.

questions.label: Intro
questions.text: Introduce yourself — your name, your role at Roadworthy Title & Registration, and the problems you solve for vehicle owners.

questions.label: Before
questions.text: Before Panicci Ventures, what did your online presence look like — and what pushed you to finally invest in it?

questions.label: Why Sammy
questions.text: Title and registration is a trust business. Why hand your website and search visibility to Sammy and Panicci Ventures?

questions.label: What We Handle
questions.text: Walk us through what Panicci Ventures built and runs for you — the new site, and the searches we're now tracking that your customers actually type.

questions.label: The Build
questions.text: You just launched a brand-new site with us — from the first call to going live, what was that process actually like?

questions.label: What's Working
questions.text: What's already working — calls, form fills, customers mentioning they found you online?

questions.label: Working with Sammy
questions.text: How is working with Sammy different from other agencies you've talked to — communication, speed, month-to-month with no lock-in?

questions.label: The Goal
questions.text: Twelve months from now, what does winning on Google look like for Roadworthy — and how confident are you about getting there?

questions.label: Recommend
questions.text: What would you tell another service business owner sitting on the fence about getting serious online?

questions.label: One-liner
questions.text: Finish this sentence: “Working with Sammy P is…”

editingBrief: PARTNER TESTIMONIAL for Panicci Ventures, spoken by the owner of Roadworthy Title & Registration (roadworthytitle.com — new engagement, launch-phase story). Goal: case-study proof for panicciventures.com and pitch decks. Produce a full-length cut plus one clip per segment. BUILD, SAMMY, and GOALS are the hero clips; RECO and ONE are the ad closers. Trim dead air, burn in captions, keep the speaker centered, export per platformTargets.
